title: Oracle – Ford AV
text:
Oracle – Ford AV

# Oracle

Austin, Texas

Oracle’s Austin campus is a 565,000 SF enterprise headquarters designed to support global collaboration and innovation. Ford AV delivered a large-scale audiovisual solution across conference rooms, executive suites, and public spaces, featuring 4K displays, a central LED video wall, telepresence systems, digital signage, and intelligent audio to streamline communication across the organization.

#### Features

- 98” UHD 4K display, in-ceiling loudspeakers and 4K digital media switcher in CustomerVisit Center conference rooms
- Ceiling array microphones adjust to participant’s voice to ensure better sound quality
- 75” and 65” UHD 4K displays, telepresence camera and collaboration software in the Executive Suite for meetings and video conferencing
- 55” displays provide digital signage in 100 locations throughout campus

#### Participants

Owner: Oracle Corporation

AV Contractor: Ford Audio-Video Systems

## Partner with America’s Leading AV Technology Company

- 50+ Years of Experience – Designing and integrating innovative audiovisual systems for organizations across multiple industries.
- Nationwide AV Services – Local teams supported by a national network for dependable AV installation, maintenance, and ongoing support.
- Comprehensive Expertise – From collaboration rooms and video conferencing systems to digital signage, enterprise control systems, and managed AV services.
- Scalable, Future-Ready Solutions – Engineered for reliability, flexibility, and seamless user experiences.
- Proven Performance – Trusted by Fortune 500 companies, universities, government agencies, houses of worship, and more.
